result:
All research is complete. Here are the answers.

---

**h01** — S3 presigned-URL refresh runner — `s3presign.Runner` (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:16`) — every **12 hours** (`runner.go:27`, `runnerInterval = time.Hour * 12`; ticker loop in `Run`, `runner.go:29-41`; also runs once immediately at startup). Wired into startup in `startBackgroundRunners` at `server/server.go:162-169` (`NewRunner` at `:162`, immediate `RunOnce` at `:163`, ticker goroutine `Run` at `:169`), itself called from `Server.Start` at `server/server.go:129`.

**h02** — Delivery function: `webhook.Post` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120` (actual HTTP call `safeClient.Do(req)` at `:152`). Protection: `safeDialContext` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:59`, wired into the shared client's Transport (`:32-37`); it resolves the host and rejects reserved/private IPs at dial time (defeating DNS rebinding) via `isReservedIP` — `internal/webhook/validate.go:44` (CIDR list `validate.go:14-23`). A second admission-time check `ValidateURL` runs on webhook create/update — `internal/webhook/validate.go:62`.

**h03** — Abstraction package: `internal/idp` (`internal/idp/idp.go` — shared user-info contract struct `IdentityProviderUserInfo` at `idp.go:3`; note it's a common struct, not a Go interface). Implementation package: `internal/idp/oauth2` (`internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go:20`, `IdentityProvider` type). OAuth2 is the only implementation that ships (proto enum has only `OAUTH2`; SSO resolver branches only on OAUTH2 at `server/router/api/v1/auth_service_sso.go:120`).

**h04** — **No.** The MySQL driver is constructed only in the factory: `mysql.NewDB(profile)` at `store/db/db.go:22` inside `NewDBDriver`. `store/db/db.go:8` is the only file importing the `mysql` package; a repo-wide search finds no other constructor call or `&mysql.DB{}` literal, in production or test code.

**h05** — **Explicit Go code**, not a DB cascade. The reaction table has no foreign key / `ON DELETE CASCADE` in any backend (`store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:92-98`, `postgres/LATEST.sql:91-98`, `mysql/LATEST.sql:91-98`; the only cascade in each schema is on `memo_share`). Deletion is done in the driver's `DeleteUser` transaction: `deleteReactionsByContentIDsTx` (`store/db/sqlite/user_delete.go:94`, SQL at `:383`) and `deleteReactionsByCreatorTx` (`:100`, SQL at `:402`); mirrored in postgres/mysql `user_delete.go`. Store entry point `store/user.go:171`.

**h06** — Handlers (all `server/router/api/v1/`): `CreateMemo` (`memo_service.go:70`), `UpdateMemo` (`memo_service.go:401`), `DeleteMemo` (`memo_service.go:518`), `CreateMemoComment` (`memo_service_comments.go:20`), `SetMemoAttachments` (`memo_attachment_service.go:16`), `SetMemoRelations` (`memo_relation_service.go:16`). Convergence function for the create/update/delete/relation/attachment paths: `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:48` (calls `webhook.PostAsync` at `:71`). The truly universal convergence point across all paths (including comments, which call it directly) is `webhook.PostAsync` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:184`.

**h07** — Serving path for another user's avatar:
- `serveUserAvatar` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:168` (route `GET /users/:identifier/avatar` registered at `fileserver.go:124`)
- `getUserByUsername` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:715` (called at `:185`)
- `Store.GetUser` — `store/user.go:148` (checks userCache, else `ListUsers`)
- `Store.ListUsers` → `s.driver.ListUsers` — `store/user.go:136-137`
- Driver query selecting/scanning `avatar_url` — `store/db/sqlite/user.go:88` (SELECT `:159`, scan `:189`); postgres `store/db/postgres/user.go:87`; mysql `store/db/mysql/user.go:84`. Avatar is stored inline as a data-URI string in `user.avatar_url` (`store/user.go:43`) and decoded/blob-served at `fileserver.go:196,209`.

**h08** — Two declarers of `RunOnce`, both types named `Runner`:
- `s3presign.Runner.RunOnce` (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:43`) — **invoked** — caller `server/server.go:163` (and its own `Run` loop at `runner.go:36`, started at `server/server.go:169`).
- `memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27`) — **not invoked** from production (no caller; production uses the free function `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` instead).

**h09** — **6** distinct `Close` declarations (excluding tests/web): `SSEHub.Close` (`server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:99`), `Store.Close` (`store/store.go:72`), `Cache.Close` (`store/cache/cache.go:187`), and the three driver `DB.Close` (sqlite `store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:67`, postgres `store/db/postgres/postgres.go:46`, mysql `store/db/mysql/mysql.go:47`). All are called by non-test server code: `SSEHub.Close` ← `server/server.go:206`; `Store.Close` ← `server/server.go:146`; `Cache.Close` ← `store/store.go:74-76` (from within `Store.Close`); the configured driver's `DB.Close` ← `store/store.go:78` (`s.driver.Close()`).

**h10** — `util.GenUUID` — `internal/util/util.go:40` — fan-in ≈ **7** production call sites (`server/auth/token.go:194`, `server/router/api/v1/auth_service_session.go:26` & `:135`, `attachment_service_storage.go:209`, `user_service_access_tokens.go:84`, `shortcut_service.go:154`, `sso_username.go:15`). (Generic names like `New` count higher but aren't a single declaration.)

**h11** — 1st: **`store.User`** (~6-7 packages outside store/: `server/auth`, `server/notification`, `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/fileserver`, `server/router/frontend`, `server/router/rss`). 2nd: **`store.Memo`** (~5-6: `server/notification`, `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/frontend`, `server/router/rss`, `server/runner/memopayload`).

**h12** — Concrete method: `(*DB).CreateMemo` in the **sqlite** driver — `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:16`, INSERT executed at `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:41-42`. Determination: default driver is `sqlite` (`cmd/memos/main.go:122,130` set default `"sqlite"`; `internal/profile/profile.go:30,110`), which the factory switch in `store/db/db.go:20-21` maps to `sqlite.NewDB`, so the mysql/postgres `CreateMemo` candidates are never reached by default.

**h13** — Interface: `markdown.Service` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:30`). Concrete impl: the `service` struct wrapping goldmark — `internal/markdown/markdown.go:57` (only runtime implementation). Constructed once via `markdown.NewService` (`markdown.go:81`) in `NewAPIV1Service` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48`). Interface holders: `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` (`v1.go:35`), `memopayload.Runner.MarkdownService` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16`), `rss.RSSService.MarkdownService` (`server/router/rss/rss.go:45`). (Plugged-in goldmark pieces: `tagParser`/`mentionParser` and `MarkdownRenderer` under `internal/markdown/parser/` and `.../renderer/`.)

**h14** — Computation site: `RebuildMemoPayload` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74`), which calls `markdownService.ExtractAll` (`runner.go:78`); AST walk in `service.ExtractAll` at `internal/markdown/markdown.go:337`. Triggers: `CreateMemo` (`memo_service.go:108`), `UpdateMemo` (`memo_service.go:447`), and batch backfill `memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` (`runner.go:52`). Extracted: `Tags` (`markdown.go:354`), and `Property` flags `Title` (`:366`), `HasLink` (`:373`), `HasCode` (`:376`), `HasTaskList` (`:379`), `HasIncompleteTasks` (`:382`); mentions are also collected but not stored in the payload.

**h15** — Distinct visibility-enforcement surfaces:
- `checkMemoReadAccess` (GetMemo / comments) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:55` (PRIVATE check `:63`)
- ListMemos filter building — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:219`
- Attachment blob serving — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:677`, `:699`
- Attachment service read gate — `server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go:445`, `:451`
- Memo-attachment listing — `server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:214`, `:222`
- Reaction access — `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:30`, `:38`, `:83`
- RSS feeds (Public only) — `server/router/rss/rss.go:90`, `:141`
- Frontend/sitemap (Public only) — `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:150`
- SSE fan-out — `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:135`

**r01** — Premise wrong: there is **no Redis** (no `redis`/`go-redis` anywhere). Actual mechanism: an in-memory cache backed by `sync.Map` — `store/cache/cache.go:66`. The user-entry TTL part is real but in-memory: `userCache` (`store/store.go:28`) built with `DefaultTTL: 10 * time.Minute`, `CleanupInterval: 5m`, `MaxItems: 1000` (`store/store.go:40-45`); TTL logic `cache.go:97-112`, cleanup loop `cache.go:199-210`.

**r02** — Premise false: there is **no rate-limiting middleware**. Searches for `ratelimit`/`limiter`/`golang.org/x/time/rate` return zero matches. The only Connect interceptors are auth/logging/cache-control (`server/router/api/v1/connect_interceptors.go`); none limit request rates.

**r03** — Premise false: there is **no nightly database-cleanup cron job**. A generic scheduler exists (`internal/scheduler/`) but is never imported by non-test code. The only scheduled background work is the s3presign runner every 12 hours (`server/server.go:153-174`); no cron scheduler is wired in.

**r04** — Premise false: there is **no message broker** — no NATS, RabbitMQ, or AMQP anywhere (zero matches in code and `go.mod`). Actual mechanism: in-process, best-effort async HTTP POST via an in-memory buffered channel `asyncPostQueue` (capacity 128, `internal/webhook/webhook.go:39`) drained by 4 goroutine workers started in `init()` (`webhook.go:42-55`); `PostAsync` drops the payload if the channel is full (`webhook.go:184-196`). No persistence, retries, or broker.

**r05** — Premise false: there is **no GraphQL schema** (no `graphql`/`gqlgen` code, no `.graphql` files). Actual API surface: Protobuf-defined services exposed over Connect RPC (`connectrpc.com/connect`) with HTTP/REST mapping — proto in `proto/api/v1/`, handlers in `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go`, generated code under `proto/gen/api/v1`.
